ssvep.subtitle: Steady-state visual evoked potentials · Four-target screen stimulation
ssvep.description: Follow each target cue while recording eight EEG channels and stimulus events. Visit targets in sequence for each repetition.
ssvep.safety: Photosensitivity notice: synthetic and Cyton modes flash full-screen and may cause discomfort. People with photosensitive epilepsy or related history should not participate. Press Esc or Q immediately if uncomfortable. Workflow demo mode does not flash.

ssvep.refresh_note: 60 Hz is illustrative. Production acquisition must measure refresh timing and validate frame schedules.
ssvep.formula: Total = 5-second preparation + stimuli + inter-trial rests. No rest after the last trial.
ssvep.countdown_note: Start begins a real 5-second countdown. Acceleration applies only to the simulated recording.
ssvep.acknowledge: I have read the photosensitivity notice and can abort with Esc / Q
ssvep.allow_draft: Technical validation only: allow draft protocol or incomplete channel map
ssvep.production: Production task uses full-screen stimuli. This UI prototype remains static.
